snippets.snippet_text: "I purchased a piece of wall art on Etsy that stated a 14 day return window so I felt it was safe to order the product. Upon opening the product, I immediately knew it was poor quality and did not appear as the Etsy photo. I immediately placed it back in the box and contacted the seller for return. After a few correspondence and her trying to talk me into keeping it, I stood firm and reminded her of the return policy as stated on the website. She then gave me her return address. It was in the county of Turkey, I was not aware if this prior to purchase or I would have never bought it. I took it up to UPS to get a price to send it back and it was over $1100.00."

"I find most Etsy sellers to be very honest and helpful. I can find very unusual and high-quality items not available elsewhere. The site is sometimes challenging to navigate, but worth the effort. Sure, there are some dishonest sellers, but I find Etsy sellers far more honest than those on eBay. Also when a recent purchase did not arrive both Etsy and the seller got a refund to my credit card in 48 hours, 30 minutes. That is why I prefer Etsy."
